name: triage-graph
blurb: Multi-agent incident triage on LangGraph with a human approval gate enforced in code, plus a CrewAI port and a written comparison of the two.

name: sqlguard-mcp
blurb: An MCP server that lets an agent query a SQLite database and refuses any write until a human approves that exact statement.

name: atlas-graph-db
blurb: A graph database written from scratch in TypeScript, with a write-ahead log, crash recovery, atomic transactions and a Cypher-like query language (AQL).

name: llm-contract-router
blurb: Routes requests across LLM providers behind one interface, validates each answer against your schema, and re-prompts with the constraint that failed.

name: noisefloor
blurb: A regression harness for non-deterministic systems that measures run-to-run noise before calling a change a regression.

name: runon
blurb: Runs plain shell-script programs on your machine, one server, or a named group of servers over your own SSH, and is published on PyPI.

name: rag-knowledge-agent
blurb: A command-line retrieval agent that answers from a folder of documents with citations, and refuses without calling the model when no evidence clears its confidence floor.

name: local-network-mcp
blurb: An MCP server for local network, system and SSH tasks, where shell commands, remote commands and process kills stay denied until the operator opts in.

name: My Stream
blurb: An AI publishing platform. Scrape sources, score them against a quality threshold, and draft articles in your editorial voice.

name: Mushaf
blurb: A focused, ad-free digital Quran reader for the web, built for fast page navigation and a layout that respects the printed Mushaf.

name: My Stream - القرآن الكريم
blurb: A long-running Quran app for Android, with reciter audio, bookmarks and offline reading.
